description: This file defines the ResourcesNotAccessibleException class, a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to signify that resources could not be accessed due to missing authorization. It includes methods to construct instances from messages or JSON objects, and a builder class for flexible creation.

classes.name: ResourcesNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A custom immutable exception indicating that resources could not be accessed due to authorization issues. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException, providing static methods to create instances from messages or JSON payloads, as well as a builder class.

classes.name: ResourcesNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for ResourcesNotAccessibleException facilitating flexible and fluent construction of exception instances.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for ResourcesNotAccessibleException with specified PolicyId and label.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a ResourcesNotAccessibleException instance using a custom message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ResourcesNotAccessibleException instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ResourcesNotAccessibleException with updated headers.
